Chief Executive Officer -Reference CSJMIF/2024/16
Post 01
Nature of Post The contract will be for 1 year contract extendable to 3 to 5 years based on appraisal
of performance.
Emoluments Fixed Goss Emoluments: Rs 60000-Rs 100000 pm
Eligibility Criteria
Education Qualifications
Postgraduate in any disciplines from a recognized national or international institution with good
academic track record. Post graduate with MBA desirable
Work Experience
An individual with impeccable track record having minimum 4-5 years of overall experience in the
industry/ related institutions, Start-up (as Founder/Co-Founder) and/ or an enabler of Start-
up,Innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem by virtue of managing/ leading/ coordinating key
activities or its flagship programmes.
Desirable
 A highly motivated individual looking to work in the start-up ecosystem.
• Prior experience as a startup founder or with a relevant VC/ Angel investment firm.
• Overall understanding of the start-up incubation process and related challenges.
• Strong execution skill set – including a focus on decision making, comfort with ambiguity, and
ability to drive rapid “learn and implement” iterations, strong bias for action and outcomes-based
orientation.
• Good overall leadership and networking skills.
• Fluent in written and spoken English with excellent communication skills
• Experience of running multi-functional teams.
• Excellent skills in the entire Microsoft Office Suite
Responsibilities
 Creating robust entrepreneurial ecosystem with experience in CSR raising/ revenue creation,
strategic planning, execution of incubation programs/ grants,
 Work with startups at the Centre according to the frameworks and mechanisms as outlined by the
Incubator leadership team.
 Monitor business performance of portfolio start-ups, interface with other stakeholders and provide
industry connects
 Industry, Alumni networking and initiating outreach programs
 Identify key verticals and generate insights, use-cases and industry analyses for internal and
external usage.
 Ensuring coordination with relevant team members within the organization.

coordinating key activities or its flagship programmes.
Desirable
 In-depth knowledge of emerging technologies AL/ML/ Electronic systems architecture, design and
development
 Hands-on experience with project management
 Outstanding communication, interpersonal and leadership skills
 Ability to conduct technological analyses and research
 Proactive problem solving
 Fluent in written and spoken English with excellent communication skills
• Experience of running multi-functional teams.
Responsibilities
 Mentoring, networking of Start Ups for all technological needs
 Represent the technological agenda in staff meetings and when making hiring decisions
 Identify, compare, select and implement technology solutions to meet current and future needs
 Create overall technology standards and practices and ensure adherence
 Oversee all system design and changes in system architecture
 Establishment of Makers Lab, Rapid Protoyping Lab and Liaoning/MOU with Incubators/
Accelerators/ CoE/ Fab Labs for all Start Up needs
 Take the initiative in thought leadership, innovation and creativity
 Work closely with Marketing, Business Development and Operations to define and deliver new
products and enhancements

Post 01
Nature of Post The contract will be for 1 year contract extendable to 3 to 5 years based on appraisal
of performance.
Emoluments Fixed Goss Emoluments: Rs 40000-Rs 50000 pm
Eligibility Criteria
Education Qualifications
Candidate must hold Post Graduate or equivalent degree in any discipline from recognized Institution
with good academic record
Work Experience
An individual with an strong track record having with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in Incubation
Center management/ As a Start Up entrepreneur.
Desirable
 A highly motivated individual looking to work in the start-up ecosystem.Strong soft skills
• Experience of Operations/ leading/ coordinating Innovation & entreprenurship key activities
• Fluent in written and spoken English with excellent communication skills
• Experience of conducting workshops, hackathons, boot camps.
• Excellent computing skills
Responsibilities
 Ensure smooth day-to-day overall functioning of the incubator, by coordinating with
Administration, Funding Agency and other relevant team members.
 Pre-incubation: Deal Flow generation, Screening of proposals, Research, Patent landscaping,
working with entrepreneurs for their proposals, resenting proposals to the next level for selecting
incubates.
 Incubation: Lead formation of new business and provide incubation facilities to enable
commercialization of the business: To induct new entrepreneurs; create Incubation plans and
implement them, assist in writing business plans, keep track of the Incubation process; help the
incubates prepare proposals for getting funding, etc.
 Events and workshops: Plan various workshops/events/webinars for the Incubator, and execute the
same with the help of team members.
 Mentor Network: Develop the mentor network for the Incubator and work with them to make the
Incubated venture successful.
 Establish MOU/Partnerships: Forge partnerships with other organizations for providing services to
the incubates or the incubator; marketing the incubator, sponsorships tc. Liaison with the
government and industries. Manage social media, branding of Incubation Center
 Execute Entrepreneurship Development and Skill Training Programs for Campus and affiliate
Colleges students, faculty, Start Up enthusiasts
 Execute activities of Institute Innovation Council of CSJM University Kanpur

Post 01

Emoluments Fixed Goss Emoluments: Rs 12000 pm
Eligibility Criteria
Education Qualifications
Candidates should have a background in law, intellectual property law, or a related field. This could
include students pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB/BALLB/BBALLB), a Master's degree in
Law (LLM), or a degree/diploma in a related field such as Intellectual Property Rights or Patent Law.
Desirable: Proficiency in using IT systems such as Microsoft365, SharePoint, MS Word, PowerPoint,
Excel. Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Responsibilities
 Conduct legal research on intellectual property laws, regulations, and precedents
 Contribute to the development of intellectual property strategies for protecting and managing the
office's innovations and inventions.
 Support in drafting legal documents
 Aid in the preparation and filing of patent, trademark, and copyright applications with relevant
authorities.
 Ensure compliance with intellectual property laws and regulations in all innovation activities
undertaken by the office.
 Maintain accurate records of intellectual property assets, agreements, and legal correspondence.
 Collaborate with other members of the Dean Innovation Office, as well as external legal counsel
and stakeholders, and effectively communicate legal concepts to non-legal team members.
 Assist with any other legal or administrative tasks as assigned by supervisors within the Dean
Innovation Office.
